root.label: Ola Bini receives conditional sentence suspension

events.label: Ola Bini receives conditional sentence suspension

slots.name: prison sentence
slots.sentence: On April 5, 2024, an appeals court overturned that ruling and sentenced him to one year in prison for attempted unauthorized access to a computer system.

slots.name: sentence suspension status
slots.sentence: Three days later, a court granted Bini a conditional suspension of the sentence.

slots.name: criminal case status
slots.sentence: Bini's defense said before Thursday's immigration proceeding that the criminal case had since expired and that restrictions imposed on him had been lifted.
